title: TRICARE Prime Draft-on-File Amount and the Account History It Weighs
content:
**Rule.** The region's draft on a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment is toward the installment whose coverage period begins latest and draws that installment's whole open amount, its charge less the payments posted against it, less the whole excess of the account history running from the first month of the plan year in which the history ends, with nothing kept for the next installment, never below zero, rounded to the cent and taken through the method on file. The annual fee of the enrollment's fee arrangement is the tier's annual individual fee for an individual arrangement and its annual family fee for a family arrangement.

## Definitions

- **End of the history.** The history runs through the end of the last closed installment period of the enrollment's payment arrangement: the month before the current month for a monthly arrangement, the last month of the previous calendar quarter for a quarterly arrangement and December of the previous plan year for an annual one.
- **When a charge begins.** Every installment charge on the account begins on the first day of the period it covers, except a first installment, which begins on the enrollment's effective date; a charge begins in the month containing that day.
- **Look-back for payments and refunds.** Payments and refunds are weighed over the look-back of that history: what was posted after the date that falls as many months before today as there are calendar months from its starting month through the current month - on the same day of the month as today, or on the last day of that month where it is shorter - through today.
- **Excess.** Where the payments posted on the account within that look-back, other than payments against the drafted installment and against the installment whose coverage period begins latest, less the refunds posted within it, exceed the installment charges whose coverage begins from that starting month through the end of the history, other than the drafted installment, that excess, less what the region keeps on the account for the next installment, comes off what the draft draws.
- **The draft.** The region's draft is the smaller of the open amount and the limit on one draft, less what comes off, never below zero, rounded to the cent; one draft may draw the whole open amount.
- A monthly figure of the annual fee is the annual fee divided by 12, and a quarterly figure the annual fee divided by 4, each rounded to the cent. Months are calendar months, numbered continuously from January 2000.

## Worked figure (hypothetical)

TRICARE Prime Retiree Group B, individual arrangement, monthly installments of 40.39 by electronic funds transfer; today is 10 August.

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Installment drafted: the August charge, nothing paid against it | open amount 40.39 |
| History: January through July (monthly arrangement ends with the month before the current month) | - |
| Look-back: January through August is 8 calendar months, so entries posted after 10 December of the previous year through today | - |
| Payments posted in the look-back other than against the August installment | 7 payments of 40.39 plus an extra 10.00: 292.73 |
| Refunds posted in the look-back | 0.00 |
| Charges whose coverage begins January through July | 282.73 |
| Excess, all of which comes off | 10.00 |
| Draft: 40.39 less 10.00 | 30.39 |

For an annual arrangement drafted in August, the history ends with December of the previous plan year and runs from the January of that year.
